phase_title: 測定ワークフロー実行許可候補の最終証跡固定レポート設計
phase_purpose: Phase 17-7 で合成された最終判定結果（PROCEED_TO_MEASUREMENT_EXECUTION、HOLD_PENDING_AUTHORITY_OR_REMEDIATION、HALT_DO_NOT_EXECUTE_MEASUREMENT）を受け取り、PROCEED 判定を受けた場合、その結果を最終的に固定し、権限者の Digital signature を付与し、Phase 15-7/15-8 測定ワークフロー実行の最終許可証となるレポートを設計する。改ざん検出、タイムスタンプ、監査ログ、権限者承認記録を含む。
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of final authorization evidence lock report structure only, no actual authorization locking or signature operations yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Phase 17-8 final authorization evidence lock report is design-only; no actual authorization locking, signature operations, or measurement execution occurs. No app/tests implementation permitted.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual authorization signing or measurement execution occurs.

final_authorization_evidence_lock_purpos.purpose: Lock Phase 17-7 final judgment result and authorize Phase 15-7 and/or Phase 15-8 measurement workflow execution by applying authority digital signature
authorization_targets: Phase 17-7 final judgment result (PROCEED_TO_MEASUREMENT_EXECUTION, HOLD_PENDING_AUTHORITY_OR_REMEDIATION, or HALT_DO_NOT_EXECUTE_MEASUREMENT)
Individual Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 execution authorization (if PROCEED result)

authorization_scope.if_overall_proceed: Authorize Phase 15-7 and/or Phase 15-8 measurement execution with authority signature
authorization_scope.if_overall_hold: Record authority deferred decision; authorization is NOT issued; measurement execution is suspended
authorization_scope.if_overall_halt: Record halt decision; authorization is NOT issued; measurement execution is forbidden

evidence_lock_mechanism: SHA-256+ cryptographic hash of Phase 17-7 final judgment report
Digital signature (e.g., RSA-2048, ECDSA) by measurement authority

report_header.report_timestamp: ISO8601 UTC when final authorization report created
report_header.authorization_status: AWAITING_AUTHORITY_SIGNATURE or AUTHORIZED or AUTHORIZATION_DENIED or AUTHORIZATION_DEFERRED
report_header.report_purpose: Final authorization evidence lock for Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement execution

phase17_7_final_judgment_reference.judgment_report_id: Reference to Phase 17-7 final judgment report

authorization_decision_logic.logic_rule_1: IF Phase 17-7 overall result == PROCEED_TO_MEASUREMENT_EXECUTION THEN proceed to authority signature workflow (step 1 below)
authorization_decision_logic.logic_rule_2: IF Phase 17-7 overall result == HOLD_PENDING_AUTHORITY_OR_REMEDIATION THEN record deferred decision and await authority judgment
authorization_decision_logic.logic_rule_3: IF Phase 17-7 overall result == HALT_DO_NOT_EXECUTE_MEASUREMENT THEN record halt decision; authorization denied; skip signature workflow

document_content: Phase 17-7 final judgment report hash and verification

step_2_authority_review.action: Authority reviews Phase 17-7 final judgment and decides to authorize or withhold authorization
authority_decision_options: AUTHORIZE_FULL: Sign authorization; both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 can execute immediately
AUTHORIZE_PHASE15_7_ONLY: Sign authorization for Phase 15-7 only; Phase 15-8 execution deferred or blocked
AUTHORIZE_PHASE15_8_ONLY: Sign authorization for Phase 15-8 only; Phase 15-7 execution deferred or blocked
WITHHOLD_AUTHORIZATION: Refuse to sign; measurement execution halted pending remediation

step_3_digital_signature.action: Authority applies digital signature to authorization document

signature_elements.signature_algorithm: RSA-2048, ECDSA P-256, or approved equivalent
signature_elements.signature_private_key_storage: Hardware security module (HSM) or trusted key store; never in plain text
signature_elements.signature_scope: Authorizes Phase 15-7 and/or Phase 15-8 measurement execution

step_4_record_authorization_grant.action: Record authorization grant with signature and metadata

record_elements.authorization_validity_duration: How long authorization remains valid (e.g., 24 hours, or indefinite until Phase 15-7/15-8 complete)
record_elements.authorization_conditions: Any conditions attached to authorization (e.g., 'execute Phase 15-7 first, then Phase 15-8')

authorization_hold_workflow_if_hold.action: If Phase 17-7 result is HOLD, record deferred decision

record_elements.defer_reason: Which component is in HOLD (Phase 15-7, Phase 15-8, or both)

authorization_denial_workflow_if_halt.action: If Phase 17-7 result is HALT, record authorization denial

record_elements.denial_reason: Why measurement execution is forbidden (blocking gate failure, lock tampering, state inconsistency, etc.)
record_elements.forensic_evidence_reference: Link to root cause analysis and forensic evidence
record_elements.remediation_required_before_retry: What must be fixed before Phase 17-7 re-evaluation can occur

lock_elements.phase17_7_judgment_hash: Hash of Phase 17-7 final judgment report
lock_elements.final_authorization_document_hash: Hash of final authorization document (including signature)
lock_elements.evidence_lock_timestamp: ISO8601 UTC when evidence lock created

audit_trail.type: append-only log of authorization workflow events

log_entries.event_type: JUDGMENT_RECEIVED | AUTHORITY_REVIEW_INITIATED | AUTHORITY_DECISION_RECORDED | SIGNATURE_APPLIED | AUTHORIZATION_GRANTED | AUTHORIZATION_WITHHELD | AUTHORIZATION_DEFERRED

audit_trail.immutability: Append-only; prior entries cannot be modified or deleted

authorization_record_storage.storage_requirements: Final authorization records must be stored with high availability and tamper-proof properties
storage_options: Blockchain or ledger technology (immutable distributed ledger)
Archive storage with digital signatures and timestamps
authorization_record_storage.access_control: Only authorized roles (measurement authority, Phase 15-7/15-8 executors) can read; write access restricted to authorization workflow system

measurement_execution_authorization_cert.certificate_purpose: Final document that Phase 15-7 and/or Phase 15-8 measurement workflows will check before executing

certificate_contents.signature: Authority digital signature over all above fields

measurement_execution_authorization_cert.certificate_verification_at_phase15_7_8_: Before Phase 15-7 or Phase 15-8 begins execution, retrieve and verify authorization certificate: (1) signature valid, (2) timestamp current, (3) target phase authorized, (4) judgment hash unchanged

failure_scenario_1_signature_invalid.scenario: Authority signature on authorization document is invalid or tampered with
failure_scenario_1_signature_invalid.response: HALT measurement execution; alert authority; preserve forensic evidence; request signature reapplication

failure_scenario_2_judgment_hash_mismatc.scenario: Phase 17-7 final judgment report has been modified since authorization was granted
failure_scenario_2_judgment_hash_mismatc.detection: Hash verification fails during Phase 15-7/15-8 entry
failure_scenario_2_judgment_hash_mismatc.response: HALT measurement execution; security incident; forensic investigation; request re-authorization after investigation

failure_scenario_3_authorization_expired.scenario: Authorization validity period has expired before Phase 15-7/15-8 begins
failure_scenario_3_authorization_expired.response: Request fresh authorization from authority; re-evaluate if circumstances have changed

failure_scenario_4_authority_revocation.scenario: Authority issues revocation order after authorization was granted
failure_scenario_4_authority_revocation.detection: Authority revocation order in audit trail
failure_scenario_4_authority_revocation.response: HALT measurement execution immediately; audit trail documents revocation; preserve evidence

depends_on: Phase 17-7: Final judgment report (provides PROCEED/HOLD/HALT result to authorize or deny)
feeds_into: Phase 17-9: Phase 17 final handoff gate layer completion declaration (receives authorization evidence lock completion verification)
Phase 15-7: Measurement workflow (uses authorization certificate to verify execution permission)
Phase 15-8: Measurement workflow (uses authorization certificate to verify execution permission)

design_review_checklist: Final authorization evidence lock purpose clearly stated
Authorization scope (both Phase 15-7/15-8, or one only, or none) defined
Signature workflow (4 steps) for PROCEED case complete
Hold workflow for HOLD case defined
Denial workflow for HALT case defined
Authority decision options enumerated (AUTHORIZE_FULL, AUTHORIZE_PHASE_ONLY, WITHHOLD)
Evidence lock mechanism (hashes, timestamp, signature) specified
Measurement execution authorization certificate structure defined
Authorization verification at Phase 15-7/15-8 entry specified
All blocked actions remain in governance

completion_gate.gate_condition: Final authorization evidence lock structure approved AND authorization workflows finalized
completion_gate.approval_required: Human technical reviewer + Phase 17 design authority + Authority signature protocol lead
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 17-9 (Phase 17 final handoff gate layer completion declaration) can begin once Phase 17-8 authorization structure is complete
